command.formatAtCursor.title: Inline SQL: Format at Cursor
command.formatAtCursor.description: Format the inline SQL candidate containing the cursor.
command.formatSelection.title: Inline SQL: Format Selection
command.formatSelection.description: Format inline SQL candidates intersecting the selection.
command.formatAll.title: Inline SQL: Format All in Document/Cell
command.formatAll.description: Format all inline SQL candidates in the current document or cell.
configuration.title: Inline SQL Toolkit
configuration.format.keywordCase.descrip: Controls the letter case used for SQL keywords.
configuration.format.indentWidth.descrip: Controls the number of spaces used for SQL indentation.
configuration.format.wrapAfter.descripti: Sets the preferred line length for wrapping SQL in triple-quoted strings.
configuration.format.useSpaceAroundOpera: Controls whether spaces are inserted around SQL operators.
configuration.format.dialect.description: SQL dialect used by the formatter.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: Inline SQL formatting is disabled until this workspace is trusted.
configuration.format.replaceOrdinals.des: Opt-in: replaces GROUP BY and ORDER BY ordinal numbers (1, 2, ...) with the referenced select expression (the alias in ORDER BY) when formatting. An ordinal whose replacement could change the query's meaning is kept.
configuration.format.commaPosition.descr: Chooses where a comma that wraps to the next line sits: "after" keeps it at the end of the previous line, "before" moves it to the start of the next line with a space after it.
configuration.format.keepFunctionsInline: Keeps function calls (SUM(...), COUNT(CASE ... END), ...) on a single line instead of breaking their arguments across lines.
